hooks.command: branch=$(git -C "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo ""); if [ "$branch" = "main" ] || [ "$branch" = "master" ]; then echo 'Refusing edit on '"$branch"'. Create a feature branch first: git checkout -b <type>/<short-desc>. See AGENTS.md > Branch hygiene.' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
